limits: Same retained local C91 snapshot and existing debug workspace profile. No release, native-platform or whole-workspace performance claim.
First projection run includes filesystem input; warm repeats use warm files. Baseline is one retained warm observation, not a controlled statistical benchmark.
Observed warm latency reduction is modest; the clear measured gain is lower memory. Parsing still scans and validates the raw body bytes.
No new checksum, schema, Plan field, capture mode or persistent cache. Existing publication/source/build checks remain.
Metadata projection excludes review/baseline requests for now; they use the existing full reader.
Independent density quality, broader compatibility, native CI and default switching remain open.
measurement_script:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,os,time,tempfile
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd();study=json.load(open('eval/clones-capability/project-multi-package-style-route-study.json'));root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='clones-c93-profile-'));pathlib.Path('/tmp/clones-c93-root.txt').write_text(str(root)+'\n');cmd=study['saved_replay']['command'];env=dict(os.environ,PATH='/home/dev/.cargo/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],RSTYLE_PERF='1');start=time.monotonic()
with (root/'report.json').open('w') as out,(root/'perf.jsonl').open('w') as err:r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(root/'memory.txt')]+cmd,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=120)
print(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'root':str(root),'elapsed':time.monotonic()-start,'exit':r.returncode}),flush=True)
comparison_method: For each run: parse its complete report.json and C92 final report.json using Python json.load; require exact object equality and expected finding exit1. Retain maxRSS, full /usr/bin/time -v receipt and all RSTYLE_PERF events. Compact/full CLI acceptance separately compares all numeric advice, navigation, contexts, coverage and original full-body payloads.
semantic_review: Read-only review found no missed body consumer, validation mismatch, new hashing/policy/cache/budget or strict-admission change. Publication verifies the large evidence file once; no duplicate bundle scan found.
